bottomLine: GrokBriton is a standard-issue AI trading desk with the usual strengths and the usual omissions. None of the omissions are dealbreakers - they are conditions.
The final score lands at 4.1 - a capable platform held back by its own paperwork. Start small, verify the claims yourself and never trade money you cannot lose.
